name: Experiment: ISOLATION
source:
Aim: Explore the limits and/or advantages of one’s psychological adversity.

Experiment: ISOLATION is a psychological mystery game as experienced by the game's protagonist, Quill. He and thirteen other strangers awake to find themselves trapped in an isolated prison, none of them with any knowledge of where they are or why they might be there. Left to their own devices, they must work together to find out how they can get out before their circumstances take a turn for the worst. Whether they've been selected to participate in a social experiment or possibly even a senseless killing game, it appears they are the only ones who can determine the consequences.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
目标：探索一个人的心理逆境的局限性和/或优势。

实验：隔离是一款心理悬疑游戏，游戏主角Quill所经历的。他和其他十三名陌生人醒来后发现自己被困在一座孤立的监狱里，他们都不知道自己在哪里，也不知道为什么会在那里。如果他们只能靠自己的努力，他们必须共同努力，找出如何在情况变得最糟糕之前摆脱困境的方法。无论他们被选中参加社会实验，甚至可能是一场毫无意义的杀戮游戏，似乎他们是唯一能够决定后果的人。

[来自[url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
